title: Uniform high-twist vanishing and section lifting from an ample scheme fibre of a proper algebraic space

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit prerequisite boundary
standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Proper algebraic spaces over a Noetherian scheme, coherent sheaves, ampleness andSerre vanishing on the chosen scheme fibre, finite graded modules, flat base change and the theorem on formal functions.

core_obligations: Obtain a twisting threshold that simultaneously controls every graded piece of the infinitesimal filtration at the chosen base point.
Use formal functions and the compatible infinitesimal cohomology sequence to deduce stalkwise higher-direct-image vanishing and surjectivity onto fibre sections.

proof_roadmap.step: Obtain a twisting threshold that simultaneously controls every graded piece of the infinitesimal filtration at the chosen base point.
Use formal functions and the compatible infinitesimal cohomology sequence to deduce stalkwise higher-direct-image vanishing and surjectivity onto fibre sections.

difficulty_reason: Serre vanishing on the single fibre does not provide one threshold for all infinitesimal layers. The source produces that uniform control and transports it back to the proper algebraic space, which is an H2 cohomological argument.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.
